machine.name: Onboarding Tutorial
machine.description: A short guided tutorial that teaches navigation, selection, placement, hints, and step progression. Designed so a new user can complete it without prior knowledge.
learningObjectives: Orient yourself in the assembly scene
Select and inspect a part to read its info
Equip and use a tool on a highlighted target
Drag or grab a part to place it at a target

assemblies.name: Onboarding Assembly
assemblies.description: Walks the user through every core interaction one step at a time.
assemblies.learningFocus: Core interactions: observe, select, use tools, place, hint, progression.

partGroups.name: Training Parts
partGroups.description: Contains the two training parts used throughout the tutorial.

parts.name: Training Beam
parts.function: A practice beam used to learn selection and placement.
parts.defaultOrientationHint: Keep the beam parallel to the floor.

parts.name: Training Bracket
parts.function: A practice bracket used to learn hint usage and a second placement.
parts.defaultOrientationHint: Align the bracket face with the target marker.

tools.name: Tape Measure
tools.purpose: Helps compare part size to target spacing.
tools.usageNotes: Observe the part dimensions before placing.

steps.name: Select and inspect a part
steps.instructionText: Tap or click the orange beam on the left. Its name, material, and tool info will appear in the Part Info panel on the right. The tutorial moves on as soon as the part is selected.
steps.whyItMattersText: Inspecting parts before placement ensures you pick the right piece for the job.

steps.name: Drag the beam to its target
steps.instructionText: Drag or grab the orange beam and move it toward the transparent ghost shape in the center. When it is close enough it will snap into place automatically.
steps.whyItMattersText: Placing parts at target positions is the core assembly action.

steps.name: Equip the tape measure
steps.instructionText: Open Tools and select Tape Measure. The tutorial will continue automatically once it is equipped.
steps.whyItMattersText: Many blueprint steps require specific tools before you can continue.

steps.name: Use the tape measure tool
steps.instructionText: With Tape Measure equipped, find the floating pulsing orb above the bracket ghost target, move the tool cursor over it, then tap or click once to record a measurement pass.
steps.whyItMattersText: This teaches using tools on specific targets before placing the next part.

requiredToolActions.successMessage: Measurement recorded on the bracket target.
requiredToolActions.failureMessage: Equip the tape measure, then tap or click the pulsing marker at the bracket target.

steps.name: Place the bracket
steps.instructionText: Now drag or grab the blue bracket and move it to its ghost target. Remember: each part only fits its own target — dropping the wrong part will flash red.
steps.whyItMattersText: Placing the correct part at the correct target is how every assembly step works.

validationRules.failureMessage: Move the beam closer to the ghost target.
Move the bracket closer to its ghost target.

hints.title: Equip tape measure
hints.message: Open Tools and select Tape Measure to continue.

hints.title: Use tape measure
hints.message: With Tape Measure equipped, tap or click the pulsing marker at the bracket target to record the measurement pass.

hints.title: Aim for the ghost
hints.message: Drag the beam toward the transparent shape in the center. Release when it turns green.

hints.title: Bracket target
hints.message: The bracket goes to the right-side ghost. Drag it close and release to snap it into place.

targets.name: Beam Target
targets.description: Where the training beam should be placed.

targets.name: Bracket Target
targets.description: Where the training bracket should be placed.
